attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file TN franchise and excise tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in TN (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "TN" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets TN economic nexus threshold ($100K or 200 transactions)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "TN" streq } over if

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - filing required for both taxes
action_details.action_dsl: add "TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to physical presence in Tennessee. Both taxes apply: 1. Franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth (greater of book value or property) 2. Excise tax: 6.5% on net earnings (apportioned income). Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2007 (Excise tax), TN Code § 67-4-2104 (Franchise tax), Form FAE 170 (Franchise and Excise Tax Return), TN Revenue Ruling 07-24 (Physical presence nexus)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to physical presence in Tennessee. Both taxes apply: 1. Franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth (greater of book value or property) 2. Excise tax: 6.5% on net earnings (apportioned income). Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2007 (Excise tax), TN Code § 67-4-2104 (Franchise tax), Form FAE 170 (Franchise and Excise Tax Return), TN Revenue Ruling 07-24 (Physical presence nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_dsl: add "TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions in TN. Economic nexus applies to both franchise and excise taxes. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), TN Code § 67-4-2007(b) (Economic nexus), TN Notice 20-11 (Marketplace Facilitator Act and Economic Nexus)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions in TN. Economic nexus applies to both franchise and excise taxes. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), TN Code § 67-4-2007(b) (Economic nexus), TN Notice 20-11 (Marketplace Facilitator Act and Economic Nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set tn_result.franchise_tax = 0.0; set tn_result.excise_tax = 0.0; set tn_result.total_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No TN nexus - no filing requirement for franchise or excise tax. Any estimated payments would be refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /tn_result.franchise_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /tn_result.excise_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /tn_result.total_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TN nexus - no filing requirement for franchise or excise tax. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate TN state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate TN state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; if revenue.federal_bond_interest != null then set apportionment.state_additions = apportionment.state_additions + revenue.federal_bond_interest; endif if result.section_199a_deduction != null then set apportionment.state_additions = apportionment.state_additions + result.section_199a_deduction; endif if result.state_income_taxes_paid != null then set apportionment.state_additions = apportionment.state_additions + result.state_income_taxes_paid; endif set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; if revenue.tn_municipal_interest != null then set apportionment.state_subtractions = apportionment.state_subtractions + revenue.tn_municipal_interest; endif if revenue.qualified_subsidiary_dividends != null then set apportionment.state_subtractions = apportionment.state_subtractions + revenue.qualified_subsidiary_dividends; endif if tn_result.nol_deduction != null then set apportionment.state_subtractions = apportionment.state_subtractions + tn_result.nol_deduction; endif add "TN state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. Additions include: Interest on federal obligations (U.S. Treasury bonds, etc.), IRC § 199A qualified business income deduction addback, State franchise and excise taxes paid (not deductible). Subtractions include: Interest on TN state and local bonds, Dividends from 80%+ owned subsidiaries, TN NOL carryforward deduction. Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2006 (Definitions of net earnings), Form FAE 170 Instructions (Schedule J - Adjustments), TN Revenue Ruling 09-13 (IRC conformity)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef { apportionment.state_additions revenue.federal_bond_interest f+ cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef } {} revenue.federal_bond_interest null streq not ifelse { apportionment.state_additions result.section_199a_deduction f+ cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef } {} result.section_199a_deduction null streq not ifelse { apportionment.state_additions result.state_income_taxes_paid f+ cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef } {} result.state_income_taxes_paid null streq not ifelse 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef { apportionment.state_subtractions revenue.tn_municipal_interest f+ cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef } {} revenue.tn_municipal_interest null streq not ifelse { apportionment.state_subtractions revenue.qualified_subsidiary_dividends f+ cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef } {} revenue.qualified_subsidiary_dividends null streq not ifelse { apportionment.state_subtractions tn_result.nol_deduction f+ cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef } {} tn_result.nol_deduction null streq not ifelse "TN state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. Additions include: Interest on federal obligations (U.S. Treasury bonds, etc.), IRC § 199A qualified business income deduction addback, State franchise and excise taxes paid (not deductible). Subtractions include: Interest on TN state and local bonds, Dividends from 80%+ owned subsidiaries, TN NOL carryforward deduction. Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2006 (Definitions of net earnings), Form FAE 170 Instructions (Schedule J - Adjustments), TN Revenue Ruling 09-13 (IRC conformity)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no TN state adjustments calculated
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "No nexus - no TN state adjustments calculated." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No nexus - no TN state adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate TN franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth. Net worth is the greater of book value or property value in TN.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe franchise tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive net worth in TN

action_details.action_comment: Calculate franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth
action_details.action_dsl: set tn_result.franchise_tax = tn_result.net_worth * tn_result.franchise_tax_rate; add "TN franchise tax calculation: Net worth × 0.25%. Combined minimum tax (franchise + excise): $100. Reference: TN Code 67-4-2104" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: tn_result.net_worth tn_result.franchise_tax_rate fmul cvd /tn_result.franchise_tax xdef "TN franchise tax calculation: Net worth × 0.25%. Combined minimum tax (franchise + excise): $100. Reference: TN Code 67-4-2104" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No net worth - franchise tax is zero
action_details.action_dsl: set tn_result.franchise_tax = 0.0; add "No net worth in TN - no franchise tax liability. Excise tax may still apply if there is net earnings." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /tn_result.franchise_tax xdef "No net worth in TN - no franchise tax liability. Excise tax may still apply if there is net earnings." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No TN nexus - no franchise tax liability
action_details.action_dsl: set tn_result.franchise_tax = 0.0; add "No TN nexus - no franchise tax liability." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /tn_result.franchise_tax xdef "No TN nexus - no franchise tax liability." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate TN excise tax: 6.5% on apportioned net earnings. Combines with franchise tax for total TN tax liability.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe excise tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate excise tax: 6.5% on apportioned income
action_details.action_dsl: set tn_result.excise_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * tn_apportionment.state_tax_rate; set tn_result.excise_tax = the maximum of (tn_result.excise_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set tn_result.total_tax = tn_result.franchise_tax + tn_result.excise_tax; set tn_result.total_tax = the maximum of (tn_result.minimum_tax) and (tn_result.total_tax); set apportionment.state_tax = tn_result.total_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "TN franchise and excise tax calculated. Excise: 6.5% on net earnings. Franchise: 0.25% on net worth. Minimum $100. Reference: TN Code 67-4-2007, 67-4-2104" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income tn_apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul cvd /tn_result.excise_tax xdef tn_result.excise_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /tn_result.excise_tax xdef tn_result.franchise_tax tn_result.excise_tax f+ cvd /tn_result.total_tax xdef tn_result.minimum_tax tn_result.total_tax fmax cvd /tn_result.total_tax xdef tn_result.total_tax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "TN franchise and excise tax calculated. Excise: 6.5% on net earnings. Franchise: 0.25% on net worth. Minimum $100. Reference: TN Code 67-4-2007, 67-4-2104" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No net earnings - excise tax is zero
action_details.action_dsl: set tn_result.excise_tax = 0.0; set tn_result.total_tax = tn_result.franchise_tax; if tn_result.franchise_tax > 0 then set tn_result.total_tax = the maximum of (tn_result.minimum_tax) and (tn_result.total_tax); endif set apportionment.state_tax = tn_result.total_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "No TN net earnings - no excise tax. Franchise tax still applies if there is net worth. Minimum $100 if franchise tax owed." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /tn_result.excise_tax xdef tn_result.franchise_tax cvd /tn_result.total_tax xdef { tn_result.minimum_tax tn_result.total_tax fmax cvd /tn_result.total_tax xdef } {} tn_result.franchise_tax 0 f> ifelse tn_result.total_tax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TN net earnings - no excise tax. Franchise tax still applies if there is net worth. Minimum $100 if franchise tax owed." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no excise tax or franchise tax liability
action_details.action_dsl: set tn_result.excise_tax = 0.0; set tn_result.total_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No TN nexus - no excise tax or franchise tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /tn_result.excise_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /tn_result.total_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TN nexus - no excise tax or franchise tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: wrapper: dispatch arrives here for TN
